extra.message: User-controlled input 'name' is directly interpolated into a template string and then rendered using jinja2.Template.render(). This leads to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI), allowing remote code execution (RCE).

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Template Directives Using a Template Engine

extra.message: A secret token is hardcoded in the configuration as SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN. This can lead to unauthorized access if the source code is compromised.
